name: yf_earnings_dates
description:
Past and upcoming earnings announcement dates for one company from Yahoo Finance (yfinance earnings_dates), about 25 rows.
Returns: {symbol, dates: [{Earnings Date, EPS Estimate, Reported EPS, Surprise(%)}]}, upcoming dates first; Reported EPS is empty for future dates.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Surprise detail for recent quarters: yf_earnings_history; the next event only: yf_calendar. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
